request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:UNDEAD:WINDMILL

layers.text: Change only one thing: the stone of the round tower. The tower walls become a lighter slate blue-grey stone (#8b92a3) with a mid-grey shade (#6a7082) and a few darker stone joints, clearly lighter than the roofs and the sails. Do not redraw anything else: the near-black charcoal roofs, the four dark ragged sails on their wooden arms, the violet windows, the door, the outline and the art style stay exactly the same, on a transparent background.
